title: Fair Stable Matching: A Nash Social Welfare Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.02354v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While traditional stable matching algorithms, such as the Gale-Shapley algorithm, prioritize stability, they may fall short of achieving equitable outcomes among participants. We study the role of \emph{Nash social welfare} (NSW) as a fairness objective in the classic \emph{stable marriage problem}. We develop \texttt{SNSW-Alg} that finds a stable matching that maximizes Nash social welfare under rank-induced utilities in $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^4)$ time, where $n$ is the number of men or women. We demonstrate that \texttt{SNSW-Alg} balances equity while preserving stability. We empirically evaluate our methods across diverse preference distributions, demonstrating significant gains in fairness without substantial losses in other key measures such as regret, egalitarian criterion, and sex equality. translated_title: 公平稳定匹配：一种纳什社会福利方法
translated_abstract: 传统的稳定匹配算法（如Gale-Shapley算法）虽然以稳定性为优先目标，但可能无法在参与者之间实现公平的结果。我们研究了纳什社会福利（NSW）作为经典稳定婚姻问题中公平性目标的作用。我们开发了SNSW-Alg算法，该算法能够在Õ(n⁴)时间内找到一个在秩诱导效用下最大化纳什社会福利的稳定匹配，其中n为男性或女性的数量。我们证明了SNSW-Alg在保持稳定性的同时实现了公平性的平衡。我们在多种偏好分布下对所提方法进行了实证评估，结果表明该方法在公平性方面取得了显著提升，同时在遗憾值、平均主义准则和性别平等等其他关键指标上没有实质性损失。我们的研究结果表明，SNSW-Alg所产生的稳定匹配在统计上不被基于……的稳定匹配所帕累托支配。
tldr: 该论文提出基于纳什社会福利的稳定匹配算法SNSW-Alg，能在Õ(n⁴)时间内找到兼顾公平与稳定性的匹配，在显著提升公平性的同时不损害遗憾值、平均主义准则和性别平等等其他关键指标。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SNSW-Alg, a Nash social welfare-based stable matching algorithm that finds a stable matching balancing equity and stability in Õ(n⁴) time, achieving significant fairness gains without substantial losses in other key measures such as regret, egalitarian criterion, and sex equality.
